flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted rate $40 standard / $50 full hookup (operator's sheet effective Nov 1 2025, Campspot read today), under $50 at the cheapest RV night. Google Maps 'Poor Farmer's Campground Inc.' open, 4.5 from 374 reviews. Operator site and Campspot live. Good Sam Park: not stated by the operator. Gateway: none within 40 km (Columbus 96 km), not needed.
Phone missing: operator and Campspot give (937) 368-2449.

Long-stay: the same sheet posts 'Seasonal perm: $1800.00/Season (May 1, 2026, through October 31, 2026.)' and 'Monthly perm: (Live-in) $500.00 per month plus electric'; the home page offers help to students 'planning to attend Hobart for 9 months' and says 'We offer seasonal camping sites with yearly, mon[thly]...'. Test 2 passes (nightly rate posted, engine sells nights); test 4 about 51-54 of 250+ sold nightly, roughly 1 in 5, passes.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront, evidence 'creek runs behind a treed buffer'): the operator sells 23 sites as '30/50 AMP w/water Creekside-Back-in' and says 'Creek - Creek runs through out the whole campground. Kids play in it and love catching the Crawdads'. Imagery shows a narrow wooded creek winding through the south and east loops with sites both sides (a small stream, so creekside at most); canopy hides the bank. The fishing pond is small and set inside the south loop.
Pin 40.13346,-84.10161 is the operator's own Campspot pin, on the dealership/office building; the camp loops lie 150-550 m east and southeast, centre ~40.1337,-84.0984 (about 275 m off).
